en.headline: Choi says new school year is running smoothly as enrolment decline persists
en.dek: The education chief said falling school-age population is a structural problem that must be faced, and that measures used to keep school numbers have been exhausted.
body: Secretary for Education Christine Choi said on Saturday that schools have operated smoothly in the first week of the new academic year, with support work proceeding in an orderly way.

Asked about class reductions and schools allocated no Primary One class, Choi said the fall in the school-age population is a structural problem driven by a lower birth rate and must be faced. She said public school places had not been sharply adjusted over the past decade while numbers declined, and that measures taken to preserve the number of schools have now been used up.

Choi said the bureau does not expect the trend to reverse within five to ten years and wants school sponsoring bodies to plan ahead. Schools may consider merging or closing so that parents and staff are not confronted with a sudden halt, she said, adding that mergers are not a “school rescue” scheme but can allow institutions to operate at a larger scale.

She also pointed to the bureau’s “Sunny Together” campus campaign for the new year, saying schools should put weight on relationships and a positive atmosphere to reduce bullying, with talks arranged for parents and teachers this month.

zh.headline: 蔡若蓮：新學年運作暢順 學齡人口下降須面對
zh.dek: 教育局局長指出生率下跌屬結構問題，保存學校數目的措施已用盡，期望辦學團體及早規劃合併或停辦。
body: 教育局局長蔡若蓮周六表示，新學年至今近一星期，整體學校運作暢順良好，各方面支援工作平衡有序。
對於有學校縮班或獲派「零班」，蔡若蓮指出學齡人口下降是結構問題，出生率下跌，必須面對現實。她說公營學額在過去十年沒有大調整，當局已採取多項措施保存學校數目，但措施已用盡，不能為保存學校數目而影響發展。
她表示，看不到五至十年內情況會有逆轉，期望辦學團體和學校及早規劃。學校可考慮合併或停辦，讓校方及家長提早準備，避免突然叫停。她強調合併並非「救校方案」，但鼓勵學校盡量做大些規模或「強強聯手」。
另外，教育局推出「友『晴』凝聚校園大行動」，蔡若蓮說期望校園著重人際關係和正面態度，減少欺凌，本月亦會為家長和老師舉辦講座。
